crossRefs.note: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as…
His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and…
Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.
and of the temple servants, whom David and the princes had given for the service of the Levites, two hundred twenty…
Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking Yahweh; and when…
All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and Yahweh’s glory was on the house. They bowed…
When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to Yahweh, and give praise in holy…
They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to Yahweh, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures…
But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to…
the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those…
His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.

translations.web: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh, because his loving kindness endures forever;
translations.bsb: With them were Heman, Jeduthun, and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the LORD, for “His loving devotion endures forever.”
translations.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever;
translations.asv: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Jehovah, because his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
